name: craft-workflow-evolution
description: Standalone evidence-backed Workflow evolution for Agent execution records.

interface.shortDescription: Distill verified execution evidence into gated Workflow drafts.
interface.longDescription: Accept sanitized execution observations, generate bounded Workflow candidates through an explicit model or Host proposal, then reuse Craft's existing evaluation, Signoff, Canary and rollback gates.
defaultPrompt: Create a bounded Workflow draft from these sanitized execution observations; do not publish it before independent evaluation.
